alert: FuseScope Collector RUM without ingest policy

annotations.description: RUM refused with reason no_policy: increases in two checks in a row (structural, needs no baseline) (CUTOVER.md §4).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", reason) (increase(otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} offset 10m))
)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", reason) (increase(otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} offset 20m))
)
